page: Google Cloud Platform a3-megagpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized bare-metal equivalent instance engineered for extreme-scale distributed artificial intelligence workloads and high-performance computing. The host system is powered by dual Intel Xeon 8481C processors running the x86_64 instruction set architecture, delivering 208 dedicated virtual CPUs across 104 physical cores with a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz and 105 MB of shared L3 cache. Advanced hardware extensions include Intel AMX (Advanced Matrix Extensions) and AVX-512 vector pipelines. Acceleration is supplied by eight NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs providing a combined 640 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM, supplemented by 1872 GB of system host memory at an allocation of 9.0 GB per core.

Local I/O capacity is supported by 6432 GB of direct-attached NVMe solid-state storage across 16 drives. Benchmark testing reflects massive parallel compute capacity, with stress-ng multi-core achieving 167,246.2 and PassMark CPU reaching 125,327.18, placing the platform in the top tier of all measured infrastructure. Cached memory read throughput reaches 13,667.21 GB/sec, while uncached large-block memory read bandwidth sustains 430.55 GB/sec. Single-threaded performance lands in the middle to upper quartiles, with a Geekbench single-core score of 2,120.0 and stress-ng single-core output of 2,050.88.

System testing demonstrates exceptional handling of data-intensive operations, delivering 180.65 million Redis SET operations per second and 103.74 GB/sec of static web throughput. Text generation metrics register at 109.24 tokens per second on 135M parameter models and 29.28 tokens per second on 7B models. From a resource-density perspective, this server consolidates substantial GPU compute, memory capacity, and fast NVMe scratch storage onto a single node, minimizing network hop latency during training cycles. The server is suited for foundational large language model pre-training, complex multi-GPU fine-tuning, large-scale deep learning inference, and memory-bound numerical simulations.
description: Google Cloud Platform a3-megagpu-8g is an accelerator-optimized compute instance designed for intensive artificial intelligence and high-performance workloads. It features eight NVIDIA Hopper H100 GPUs totaling 640 GB of VRAM, paired with 208 dedicated vCPUs from Intel Xeon 8481C processors on x86_64 architecture running at 2.7 GHz. System resources include 1872 GB of host RAM and 6432 GB of local NVMe SSD storage. Benchmark results place this instance in the top tier for multi-core throughput, recording a stress-ng multi-core score of 167,246.2 and 430.55 GB/sec of uncached read memory bandwidth. It also delivers 180.65 million Redis SET operations per second and handles multi-billion parameter model execution. This high-density architecture provides balanced compute, memory, and high-speed local disk capacity, making it appropriate for large language model pre-training, distributed deep learning fine-tuning, and massive parallel simulation pipelines.
